records.text: The recording presented as Charlie Kirk appointing Erika Kirk CEO did not occur at the Aspen event.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep k1b1NDCrNFs)

appearances.snippet: You got donors who say that the Charlie (Charlie Kirk) voice saying that he appoints Erika (Erika Kirk) as CEO, which you guys allege took place at the Aspen events. Donors that were in attendance say that that did not happen. Blake (Blake Neff), what say you? Can you please drop the video?

verification.notes: Later reporting says a full recording from the Aspen donor retreat was reviewed and captures Charlie Kirk naming Erika as his preferred successor, and later public video included the statement. That directly contradicts the anonymous report that the event did not occur. Because the original full retreat recording is not openly available and authenticity disputes remain, confidence is medium rather than high.

sources.title: Charlie Kirk names his successor in newly unveiled Turning Point USA video
sources.relevance: Reports that the reviewed recording came from the August 2025 Aspen retreat and contains the succession statement.

sources.title: I Was Wrong - Team Addressed Kirk TPUSA AI Video Controversy
sources.relevance: Records a later correction after TPUSA contacts and estate-planning confirmation that the video and succession preference were real.
